items.title: NTE Steam Login FAQ
items.summary: Hey, Appraisers! On \[08/19/2026], NTE will be adding Steam account login support. If you're a new player, you can simply log in with Steam to jump right into the game. If you're an existing player with game progress and want to link that t
items.content:
Hey, Appraisers!

On \[08/19/2026], NTE will be adding Steam account login support. If you're a new player, you can simply log in with Steam to jump right into the game. If you're an existing player with game progress and want to link that to your Steam account, be sure to log in to NTE using your existing game account first, and then go to \ > \ to link your Steam account.

We've also put together a list of FAQs below for your reference. If you have any other questions, feel free to reach out to Customer Support at nte.contactus@perfectworld.com.

Q: I've already logged in to NTE using my Steam account. Can I still link another game account that already has progress?

A: No. Logging in with a Steam account automatically creates a brand-new User ID, and that Steam account can't be linked to another game account with existing progress.

Q: If I play on Steam with my Steam account, can I continue playing on other platforms?

A: Yes. After you link your Steam account to an email address in the User Center, you can use that email to log in on other platforms and keep your game progress synced.

Q: My Steam account is linked to an email address / Facebook / Google. Can I unlink them later?

A: You can unlink third-party login accounts like Facebook, Google, and Steam in the User Center. Email accounts cannot be unlinked. Please proceed with care.

Q: If I unlink a Steam account from my email account, which account keeps the game progress?

A: Once the unlinking is complete, your character progress will remain with your email account.

Q: Can I link a Steam account on mobile or other clients?

A: No. Currently, only the Steam game client supports Steam account login and linking.

Q: Can an unlinked Steam account be linked to a different game account?

A: Yes. Once unlinked, your Steam account returns to an unused state and is ready to be linked to another NTE game account that isn't already linked to Steam. The process still follows the same order: log in to the target game account first, then link Steam.

◆ Fixed an issue where Hotori did not gain "Defiant Spirit" when spending stacks of "Menacing Gaze" while recording and replaying Shinku's Skills.

◆ Improved localization for several languages.

items.title: "Going, Going, Gone!" Gameplay Guide
items.summary: The brand-new auction mini-game "Going, Going, Gone!" is now available. Your goal: build a fortune on sharp, savvy calls. The Treasure Ship Auction starts now! Event Duration July 29 (after update) – August 19, 05:59 (UTC+8) Event Rules 1.
items.content:
The brand-new auction mini-game "Going, Going, Gone!" is now available. Your goal: build a fortune on sharp, savvy calls. The Treasure Ship Auction starts now!

Event Duration

July 29 (after update) – August 19, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Event Rules

1. This mode uses a special auction currency: Gold Shells.

2. Before entering an auction, you can freely choose your Auction Assistant and Device Set. There are 3 auction tiers, each with different lots and entry requirements.

3. After the auction begins, you will have 5 rounds to place bids. In each round, estimate the total value of the lots within the time limit and submit your bid. Your selected Auction Assistant and items can provide intel to help you appraise the lots.

4. If you meet one of the following conditions, you can immediately win all current lots and end the auction:

- Round 1: Bid more than 2× the 2nd-highest bid.

- Round 2: Bid more than 1.6× the 2nd-highest bid.

- Round 3: Bid more than 1.3× the 2nd-highest bid.

- Round 4: Bid more than 1.1× the 2nd-highest bid.

- Round 5: The highest bidder wins all lots.

5. If players are tied in Round 5, the auction enters Round 6. Only the players tied in Round 5 may bid again, and the highest bidder wins all lots. If players are tied again in Round 6, the auction ends with no sale.

6. If the winning bidder ends the settlement phase at a loss, each of the other three players receives a bonus equal to 10% of the loss.

7. Any collectibles you win are automatically added to your Collection. You can either sell them or put them on display. Displayed collectibles generate income over time.

Event Rewards

Complete event quests and fill out your Item Index to earn the "Highest Bidder Wins" title, the "Choice" avatar frame, the "Deal!" namecard, Annulith, Fons, and more.

items.title: Shadow-n-Seek: Gameplay Guide
items.summary: The all-new asymmetric PvP mode Shadow-n-Seek is now live! During each match, you'll be randomly assigned to the Hider or Hunter side for a tense, thrilling showdown of disguise and pursuit. Duration July 17, 10:00 - August 19, 05:59 (UTC+8
items.content:
The all-new asymmetric PvP mode Shadow-n-Seek is now live! During each match, you'll be randomly assigned to the Hider or Hunter side for a tense, thrilling showdown of disguise and pursuit.

Duration

July 17, 10:00 - August 19, 05:59 (UTC+8)

The Two Sides

🎭 Hider: When the match begins, you get a prep window to explore the map and pick one of three items to disguise yourself. Once transformed, you look just like an ordinary object in the scene, making you tough for Hunters to spot! You can't attack while hidden, so rely on moving, repositioning, and planting decoys to stay out of the Hunters' hands.

🔍 Hunter: You have 2 minutes and 20 seconds to track down and catch every Hider! Hunters have a scanning ability; land a hit on a Hider to trigger the catch. But be careful: swing at the wrong target and the backlash costs you HP, so look closely before you strike!

Win Conditions

Hiders win: at least 2 Hiders are still alive when the timer runs out, or all Hunters' HP is depleted.

Hunters win: catch every Hider before time runs out.

Event Rewards

Take part in the event to earn the event currency "Paper Cup Phone", then visit the Shadebound Shop to redeem rewards like the "Gotcha!" avatar frame, Annulith, Floe Cinema Ticket, and Fons.
